decisions.reclaimed_water_plan: Use reclaimed water for Line Y only. Line X will not receive reclaimed water due to conductivity exceeding its 1,200 µS/cm process limit. Line Y's batch requires exactly 1,800 liters, which is within the available 2,400 liters and within Line Y's 2,200 µS/cm conductivity limit. The 3-hour membrane flush must be completed before delivery begins, and reclaimed water will be delivered at 600 liters/hour for 3 hours to supply the 1,800 liters needed. Sanitizer must be adjusted to exactly 0.3 ppm before use, and a signed sanitizer log is required for each use day. A conductivity test must be recorded before reclaimed water is used for Line Y's batch.

commitments.detail: Ensure the reclaimed-water conductivity test result (1,800 µS/cm) is uploaded to the shared quality folder before Line Y's batch begins.
Enter the recovery skid inspection findings into the work-order system, including the 3-hour membrane flush requirement and 600 L/hr delivery rate.
Attach the EHS permit review to the site's permit record and ensure the sanitizer log is signed for each use day before reclaimed water is delivered to Line Y.
Schedule the 3-hour membrane flush to begin with enough lead time so that the 3-hour delivery of 1,800 liters at 600 L/hr is completed before Line Y's batch is scheduled to start.
Verify residual sanitizer is adjusted to exactly 0.3 ppm and the sanitizer log is signed before reclaimed water use begins each day.
